summary: Improve pipeline checks, release controls and recovery planning in five days. Explore CI/CD training for software delivery teams.
lede: CI/CD training helps software engineers, DevOps practitioners and release managers assess and improve pipelines that move code into production. It covers Git-based change flows, DORA delivery measures, pipeline stages and automated test gates, as well as artifact integrity, deployment risk and controls such as canary or blue-green releases. Practical exercises develop pipeline assessments, release-risk checklists, rollback decisions and improvement actions, with security references introduced at an applied level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who build, test, secure or coordinate software delivery and need to make release decisions using clear pipeline evidence.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of Git, basic command-line navigation and a software testing or release workflow. You should be comfortable reading simple YAML pipeline snippets. Programming is not required. Bring a laptop with Git installed for local workflow exercises; no CI platform account or platform installation is required.
